'''Trevor Insley''' (born December 25, 1977) is an American former professional [[Gridiron football|football]] player who was a [[wide receiver]] in the [[National Football League]] (NFL). He played [[college football]] for the [[Nevada Wolf Pack football|Nevada Wolf Pack]] from 1996 to 1999. Insley is the only player in NCAA [[NCAA Division I Football Bowl Subdivision|Division I-A]] history to gain 2,000 receiving yards in a single season.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Receiving Yards Single Season Leaders and Records |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cfb/leaders/rec-yds-player-season.html |access-date=2022-08-18 |website=College Football at Sports-Reference.com |language=en}}</ref> He is one of two players in all division NCAA history to hold this distinction.<ref>Scott Pingel accumulated 2,157 receiving yards at Division III Westminster College in 1998.</ref>

Insley holds the current records for receiving yards (2,060 as a senior) and receiving yards per game (187.3 as a senior) at the Division I-A level.<ref name="cite">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ncaa.org/library/records/football/football_records_book/2004/2004_d1_football_records.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070930222617/http://www.ncaa.org/library/records/football/football_records_book/2004/2004_d1_football_records.pdf|url-status=dead|title=NCAA.org - The Official Site of the NCAA|archive-date=September 30, 2007|website=www.ncaa.org}}</ref>  Insley possesses the second most career receiving yards in Division I-A history with 5,005 yards. His other records include most 200 yard receiving games (6), second most 100 yard receiving games (26), and third most career receptions (298).

Insley was signed as an [[undrafted free agent]] in [[2000 NFL season|2000]] by the [[Indianapolis Colts]].  His three-year NFL career with the Colts and the [[Houston Texans]] ended in [[2002 NFL season|2002]].  He was allocated by the Colts to [[NFL Europe]] where he starred for the [[Barcelona Dragons (NFL Europe)|Barcelona Dragons]] in 2001.

From November 6, 1999, until November 25, 2016, Insley held the record for most all-time career receiving yards in Division I-A competition (now [[Football Bowl Subdivision]]). [[Western Michigan Broncos football|Western Michigan]] wide receiver [[Corey Davis (wide receiver)|Corey Davis]] broke his record in a game against Toledo.
